title: Prawn and Toast Quesadilla
description: A twist on the classic quesadilla, this Mexican dish combines the flavors of toasted prawns with crispy toast.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the prawns and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, toast the bread slices until crispy.
In a separate pan, warm the tortillas over medium heat.
Place a tortilla in the pan and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
Add a few slices of toasted prawns on top of the cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve with salsa and cilantro.
